_what: Brew and Stew, a woodland tea room in a cabin on the Campgrounds, pitch 04. Ryan Boren's brief, 2026-10-04: herbal teas and plant-based soups in a cottage or cabin in the woods, on the Campgrounds; a menu of herbal teas, vegan soups and vegan breads; flower, grass and twig arrangements to take to your table; a fantasy woodland cottage, cosy and mystical; the look at your table from Pekoe and Purrs; and a rack of the videos he listed. tools/make-brew-and-stew.py builds the room, the view down at your table, the menu, the arrangements, the rack and the credits out of this file. Your table is table.js's, the same behaviour as Pekoe and Purrs' in this room's own clothes.
_menu: EVERYTHING ON THE BOARD IS VEGAN, and the tool refuses anything that is not, checked with Hey, Good Cookin's own engine: its allergens(), animals() and check_dish(), imported, so the two kitchens cannot disagree about a word. Honey is refused with them, which is why every tea comes with maple syrup on the side. Every tea is a tisane, never the tea plant, and its caffeine line is worked out by Pekoe and Purrs' engine from what is in it; the tool refuses a tea with any caffeine. NOTHING HERE IS A REMEDY: herbal tea is sold everywhere as a cure for something, and the tool refuses that vocabulary in the room's voice, with the negation window. NOTHING HERE WAS FORAGED: a tea room in a wood is exactly where a menu starts telling people what they can pick, and the tool refuses that vocabulary too, Mycelium Munchies' rule, narrowed because this room's address really is in the woods. A `look` is the colour of what is in the cup, the bowl or on the board, never the stoneware.

menu.title: Herbal teas
menu.lede: Every tea is a pot for one, poured into a stoneware beaker, and every one is a tisane: flowers, leaves, roots, seeds or fruit, and none of the tea plant, so there is no caffeine in any of them. Maple syrup on the side, for anybody who sweetens.

_arrangements: FLOWERS, GRASSES AND TWIGS TO TAKE TO YOUR TABLE, from the shelf by the door. Every one was grown in the cottage garden or dried from last year's, and nothing in one was picked in the wood, which the tool holds with the foraging vocabulary. Nothing in an arrangement is food, and the room says so. Every plant is named the way a florist would name it, never in Latin: the herbarium's reason, because a name typed from memory reads as a determination. `stems` are what the tool draws: lavender, grass, catkin, pod, puff, frond, twig, heather and thistle, each in a colour of the room's own.

_videos: THE LOOKING-GLASS'S RACK. Ryan's pick, 2026-10-04, in the order he gave them: other people's woodland tea rooms and cottages, most of them ASMR. Each id was asked of its own watch page on 2026-10-04 and every one answered OK and playable on other sites; the title, the channel and the runtime are what that page said, the runtime measured off its length and never typed. The titles are the channels' and are quoted as written, and the room's sweeps skip them; one of them says anxiety relief, which is the channel's word and not a claim of this room's. A video is an id, a title, a channel, a runtime and the day it went up, and a held one carries why it is held. check-jukebox.py asks after every one with every other facade on the street.
